aileCommonSteps.3: Compare an AI intervention with simpler non-AI options. Specify what the human decides, what the AI may suggest, and which tradeoffs are acceptable.
aileCommonSteps.4: Create the smallest usable prototype around one representative task, with expert-curated content, visible uncertainty, and an easy human override.
aileCommonSteps.6: Pilot with a small, representative group in a near-real setting; preserve a baseline or comparison condition and document implementation conditions.
aileCommonSteps.7: Look for capability growth and transfer, not just satisfaction or activity. Inspect subgroup patterns, human workload, errors, and unintended adaptations.
aileCommonSteps.8: Let the evidence change the problem model. Default back to UNDERSTAND if the assumed gap was wrong; otherwise revisit the earliest step invalidated by the evidence.
